event_id IN

select event_name from basic_event_result_report where event_name in ('热态启动模式','冷态启动模式','温态启动模式') and all_event_code = #{param.event_code} and occur_time BETWEEN #{param.start_time}::timestamp and #{param.end_time}::timestamp limit 1
SELECT event_code, start_time, end_time, result_id, event_name, event_id, create_time from normal_event_result_report where result_pid = #{resultId}::uuid order by start_time

WITH target AS ( SELECT start_time, event_name FROM "public"."normal_event_result_report" WHERE result_id = #{resultId}::uuid ) SELECT n1.result_id FROM "public"."normal_event_result_report" n1 CROSS JOIN target WHERE n1.event_name = target.event_name AND n1.event_type = '1' AND target.start_time > n1.start_time ORDER BY n1.start_time DESC LIMIT 1

select m.* , n.event_name from material_record m left join normal_event_result_report n on n.result_id = m.event_record_id where m.event_record_id = #{resultId}::uuid or m.event_pid = #{resultId}::uuid

n1.event_id IN

WITH RECURSIVE tree AS ( SELECT * FROM normal_event_result WHERE result_id = (select n.result_id from normal_event_result n where n.event_id=#{eventId} and n.start_time is not null and n.end_time is null order by n.start_time desc limit 1)
UNION ALL SELECT child.* FROM normal_event_result child INNER JOIN tree parent ON child.result_pid = parent.result_id ) SELECT tree.*, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((COALESCE(end_time, start_time)) - (start_time))) / 60 AS minute, CASE WHEN end_time IS NULL THEN '进行中' ELSE '已完成' END AS "eventStatus" FROM tree ORDER BY start_time ;
select * from basic_event_result b where b.all_event_code = #{eventCode} and b.occur_time >= #{startTime} ORDER BY b.occur_time limit 1
select * from startstop_standard_config where node_id = #{nodeId} and type = #{condition}

WITH RECURSIVE all_result AS ( SELECT 'result' AS source, result_id, result_pid, event_name FROM normal_event_result UNION ALL SELECT 'result_report' AS source, result_id, result_pid, event_name FROM normal_event_result_report ), all_basic AS ( SELECT 'result' AS source, result_id, result_pid, event_name, event_id FROM basic_event_result UNION ALL SELECT 'result_report' AS source, result_id, result_pid, event_name, event_id FROM basic_event_result_report ), -- 向上计算真实起始层级（1:启停, 2:过程, 3:子过程） ancestor AS ( SELECT source, result_id, result_pid, 1 AS depth FROM all_result WHERE result_id = #{resultId}::uuid UNION ALL SELECT a.source, a.result_id, a.result_pid, anc.depth + 1 FROM all_result a JOIN ancestor anc ON a.source = anc.source AND a.result_id = anc.result_pid ), rec AS ( SELECT a.source, a.result_id, a.result_pid, a.event_name, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(depth) FROM ancestor), 1) AS level_no FROM all_result a WHERE a.result_id = #{resultId}::uuid UNION ALL SELECT c.source, c.result_id, c.result_pid, c.event_name, p.level_no + 1 FROM rec p JOIN all_result c ON c.source = p.source AND c.result_pid = p.result_id ) SELECT result_id, parent_result_id, event_name AS "eventName", event_id AS "eventId", CASE level_no WHEN 1 THEN '启停' WHEN 2 THEN '过程' WHEN 3 THEN '子过程' ELSE '基本事件' END AS "levelType" FROM ( SELECT level_no, result_id, result_pid AS parent_result_id, event_name, NULL::bigint AS event_id FROM rec UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS level_no, b.result_id, r.result_id, b.event_name, b.event_id FROM rec r JOIN all_basic b ON b.source = r.source AND b.result_pid = r.result_id ) t ORDER BY level_no, parent_result_id, result_id;

SELECT event_code, start_time, end_time, result_id, event_name, event_id FROM normal_event_result_report WHERE result_id = #{resultId}::uuid UNION ALL SELECT event_code, start_time, end_time, result_id, event_name, event_id FROM normal_event_result WHERE result_id = #{resultId}::uuid

SELECT material_name, material_unit, ROUND(AVG(material_value::numeric), 2) AS avg_value, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MIN(material_value::numeric) AS min_value, MAX(material_value::numeric) AS max_value FROM material_record mr WHERE mr.event_pid IS NULL GROUP BY material_name, material_unit ORDER BY material_name, material_unit;
